{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''MARC I Hub Line''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/ferc-oks-partial-service-on-marc-i-hub-line-project/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Bradford County, Pennsylvania to Lycoming County, Pennsylvania.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2011/06/03/2011-13782.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Central New York Oil and Gas Co LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2011/06/03/2011-13782.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''39 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2011/06/03/2011-13782.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''30 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2011/06/03/2011-13782.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/ferc-oks-partial-service-on-marc-i-hub-line-project/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
